row.notes: void discover(CareerSponsorsComponent *c, short sponsor_id, uint team_key): team entry from c+0x298 (0x88 stride, key +8; match on byte0 + hi16), sponsor definition from c+0x500 pointer list (def +0x10 code char*, +0x28 id); returns if either is missing or the team already has a record with that id. Else day = ([c+0x3b0]+0x2b0)/day and 0x1410f5590(team, [c+0x390], [c+0x398], [c+0x3c8], [c+0x3e0], [c+0x3c0], copy of def, day) builds the record, pushed with 0x1410fe630. If 0x1410f4270 (My Team mode + team flag 0x10 at +0x4b = player team) it posts DiscoveredSecondarySponsorCount (vtable 0x1456c55e0) on g_Game_MessageBus. [static L2 evidence in the doc; added at L1 for the lane owner to raise] CORRECTION(V9144): Lookup of team (c+0x298, 0x88 stride) and sponsor def (c+0x500) and the call to 1410f5590 plus 1410f4270 message gate all match; however the record push with 1410fe630 is not in this function (it is inside 1410f5590 at 0x1410f5933).
